data.title: Jobcenter appointment invitation (Meldeaufforderung)
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen (Team 311) summons Lea Muster to a mandatory meeting (Meldetermin) on Wednesday, 22.04.2026 at 08:15 in Room 1.18 with Frau Petzold to discuss her current professional situation, and asks her to bring her CV. Missing the appointment without a valid reason will reduce her Bürgergeld by 10% of the standard benefit rate for one month.
data.explanation: This is an official summons (Einladung) from the Jobcenter based on § 59 SGB II. Attendance is compulsory, not optional: if you don't show up and don't have a valid reason (e.g. illness proven by a doctor's note), your Bürgergeld will be cut by 10% of the standard rate for one month, as stated in the letter. Bring your CV (Lebenslauf) with you. If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter beforehand at the phone number or email given, ideally in writing, to explain your reason and try to reschedule. Keep any proof of a valid reason in case it's needed later.
